correctness.rationale: The support-avoidance implication follows from h(0)=1, convolution one at every point of A, and nonnegativity. The remaining incidence system has integer coefficients. The standalone integer-only script iterates 32768 rooted subsets for each of the five groups, checks all exact tiles by cardinality/bitset union, and proves each remaining admissible system inconsistent over Q by fraction-free elimination. Solvability over R is equivalent to solvability over Q for rational linear equations. Actual file execution checks all 163840 cases; its exact elimination was additionally cross-checked against symbolic rational matrix ranks on 800 deterministic random matrices. The converse uses the indicator of a translated tiling complement.

value.rationale: Normalized weak tiling is the Fourier-positive-free relaxation underlying spectral-to-tiling questions, and weak tiles that are not proper tiles exist in larger ambient groups. A complete classification across all five abelian isomorphism types of the first richly structured 2-power order (16) is a natural finite rigidity boundary. Four non-elementary groups receive new coverage, with exact tiling-cardinality counts and independently reproducible integer-rank obstructions, not a numerical heuristic or a substitution into an existing elementary-group theorem.
